text: Share previews: a painting's link shows its image, name, size and price
description: Open Graph tags on /p/:id, added by the worker (chat apps and social sites run no scripts). Sharing a painting in WhatsApp/Signal/Facebook then shows the painting instead of a bare link.

status.comment: 6cb79bb: server/preview.ts (HTMLRewriter) on /p/* (run_worker_first), og:title/description/image(+size)/site_name, twitter:card. Verified on local dev: tags present, og:image URL serves image/jpeg, unknown id returns the plain page, tab title follows flipping and resets on Esc. Not deployed yet; not checked with a real chat app's link preview.
